hint.goalCurrency: The goal is counted in a single currency. Donations in other currencies do not count toward it — we won't add them up at an exchange rate, or the raised amount would change after the fact.
hint.secondsPerUnit: How many seconds one unit of currency adds ({{currency}}). Zero means donations add no time.
hint.offsetMinor: Added to the raised amount. Use it when part of the sum was raised before you set up the widget.
hint.countTypes: You can pick several. Only events with an amount count — a subscription without an amount adds nothing.
hint.minAmount: Compared with the donation amount as is, without currency conversion: a threshold of 100 filters out both 100 ₽ and 100 $.
hint.channel: The channel login from twitch.tv/YOUR_CHANNEL. The chat is read anonymously: no need to connect the platform.
hint.channelConnected: Connected channel: {{channel}}. You can enter any other one too — the chat is read anonymously.
hint.messageLifetime: 0 means messages stay on screen until newer ones push them out.
hint.hiddenUsers: Comma-separated. Common bots are hidden by default.
hint.showWithoutVideo: Otherwise a guest with the camera off disappears from the frame while still talking.
hint.room: This widget's OBS link opens the video and audio of the room's guests. Keep it as safe as a password.
hint.noRooms: Create a room in the Rooms section first.
hint.roomMissing: No room selected — this widget will show nothing in OBS. Pick a room and save.
hint.roomDeleted: This widget's room was deleted — it will show nothing in OBS. Pick another room and save.

microphone.title: Voice processing

full.label: Full
full.hint: Built-in microphone, headset, speakers. The browser removes noise and echo and evens out the volume.

light.label: Light
light.hint: A good microphone without headphones. Only the speaker echo is removed; your voice stays as is.

off.label: No processing
off.hint: Studio microphone and headphones. Sound goes out as is, in higher quality.

noiseSuppression.label: Noise suppression
noiseSuppression.hint: Removes hum, keyboard and fan noise — but also breathing and quiet word endings.

echoCancellation.label: Echo cancellation
echoCancellation.hint: Keeps the room's sound from your speakers out of the microphone.

autoGainControl.label: Automatic gain
autoGainControl.hint: Evens out the volume. On a good microphone the volume “drifts” between phrases.

highQuality.label: High transmission quality
highQuality.hint: 96 kbps instead of 48, and silence is sent as is: without it, quiet word beginnings get cut off.

microphone.custom: Custom setting: doesn't match any level.
microphone.headphones: Echo cancellation is off — listen to the room with headphones only. Otherwise sound from the speakers gets into the microphone, and others hear themselves with a delay.

delivery.title: How you get the service
delivery.digital: The service is digital and is provided online through your account on this website. There is no physical delivery — nothing needs to be sent or received.
delivery.instant: Access to the Pro plan opens automatically right after the payment is confirmed, usually within a minute. No email or call is needed.
delivery.term: The service is provided for the whole paid period: a calendar month or year from the date of payment.
delivery.requirements: You need a browser and streaming software with a browser source, such as OBS Studio. Nothing from us needs to be installed.

payment.title: Payment and refunds
payment.methods: Pay by bank card, via SBP (Faster Payments System), SberPay, T-Pay or YooMoney on the secure YooKassa payment page.
payment.card: Card details are entered on the YooKassa side and are never passed to us. The receipt is issued automatically at the time of payment.
payment.renewal: The plan renews automatically using the saved payment method. We email you about every charge at least three days in advance. You can turn off renewal with one button in the Plan section — access stays until the end of the paid period.
payment.refund: You can cancel the plan at any time: we refund the remaining full days of the period within 10 days of your email to the support address in the Contacts section. See the Pro plan offer for details.
